$comment: How the Scrib adapter contract maps onto the generated components. Every Scrib value is listed; one with no shadcn equivalent says so in 'judgment'.

judgment.why: shadcn has no accent button; it maps to default
shadcn has no round button; circle buttons are delegated to the base adapter
shadcn has no status badges; they use outline plus a leading dot in the Scrib success/warning token, as the old adapter did
shadcn Card has one padding; hero is accepted and ignored
Scrib's gap separates the card's children inside one CardContent
